text: Womi mɩraha dɩdagɩrɩba bataŋ aŋaŋ Farasisi bataŋ die dɩ balɩ Yisa dɩ, “Dɩdagɩrʋ tɩ yaala fʋ yiwo mamachi wɩɩŋ aŋ tɩ ye.”
translated: You nullify the commandment of God for the sake of your tradition, O Pharisees, and you do not keep them yourselves, as Jesus said, "You teach doctrines which are human commands, but you yourselves do not keep them."

ref: So be on your guard! You don't know when your Lord will come.
text: Die wɩa nɩ gbara dama nɩ zɩ daa dieke manɩŋ nɩ Yɔmʋtieŋ dɩ bala n keŋ.
translated: Die is located in the town of Dama, and the people there live, and Yomutieŋ from there says so.

ref: Then they sat down to guard him.
text: die ba sʋʋŋ kalɩ a gbarɩ wa.
translated: He went to the house to eat and found it there.
